description: This file contains a PHP unit test class named SkillDaoTest that tests the SkillDao class for managing Skill entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The test class includes methods for setting up test data, and testing various CRUD operations and search functionalities for skills.

classes.name: SkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SkillDao data access object, including CRUD and search operations for Skill entities within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SkillDao instance and populates test data from a YAML fixture before each test method.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Skill entity by its ID and verifies its name and description.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple skills by their IDs and verifies the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with default filter parameters and verifies results count and type.

methods.name: testSearchSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with a limit set and verifies the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new Skill entity with specified name and description, and verifies the saved properties.

methods.name: testEditSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Skill, updating its name and description, and verifying the changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests the count of skills matching search filter parameters.
